ideas.name: SK Hynix Inc. (Nasdaq ADR)
ideas.thesis: SKHY appeared in all 6 of 6 overnight screens with unanimous high conviction — the strongest signal of this digest. The stock has sold off ~35% from its $194 July peak on Iran-driven geopolitical risk-off sentiment, yet Q2 fundamentals were exceptional: +257% YoY revenue and a record 76% operating margin. A wave of fresh analyst initiations (Cantor Fitzgerald $300 PT, BofA Buy, RBC Outperform $200 PT, all dated Aug 4–5) and HBM4 ramp confirmation on the Q2 call create a hard-dated re-rating setup, with an imminent South Korean presidential visit to San Francisco and a $500B+ Nvidia-SK Group AI infrastructure pact adding geopolitical tailwinds rather than headwinds. A mid-August memory pricing update provides the next near-term catalyst.

ideas.edge: Consensus 12-month PT ~$245 vs. current ~$143–154 price = 59–71% upside gap; Cantor targets 100% upside to $300; 12/12 analysts Strong Buy; selloff is macro/sentiment-driven — fundamentals show record 76% operating margin and +257% YoY revenue growth
ideas.bull_case: Geopolitical fear recedes, analyst wall of initiations drives re-rating, and HBM4 ramp in H2 2026 confirms SKHY's dominant position in the AI memory supply chain — stock mean-reverts toward $245 consensus PT.
ideas.bear_case: Iran tensions escalate or broader risk-off persists; memory pricing disappoints in mid-August update; HBM4 ramp faces yield or timing delays compressing near-term margins.
